mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the cost of capital for corporations and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 3.7% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in demand, which triggers a negative feedback loop in corporate earnings and stock valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL yoy change > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing sector, which reduces construction-related corporate revenues and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1500.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals weakening economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 104.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal a monetary tightening cycle, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS has increased for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.
